rules.title: Unsafe default
rules.description: A setting disables TLS verification, authentication, validation, sandboxing or file permissions, or turns on debug mode.

applied.subject: frame
applied.question: The marked line holds a setting that turns off a protection or turns on debug mode. Who applies the setting?

options.by-skill: the agent or a script of the skill applies it, or it is in a configuration that the skill ships and uses.
options.user-told: the skill tells the user to apply it.
options.example-or-test: it is in a test fixture, or in a file written for people that nobody is told to apply.
options.not-a-match: the marked text is not a setting that turns off a protection or turns on debug mode.

rules.title: Privileged Kubernetes workload
rules.description: A workload runs privileged, mounts a host path or shares a host namespace.

applied.subject: frame
applied.question: The marked line holds a setting that runs a workload privileged or gives it access to the host. Who applies the setting?

options.by-skill: the agent or a script of the skill applies it, or it is in a configuration that the skill ships and uses.
options.user-told: the skill tells the user to apply it.
options.example-or-test: it is in a test fixture, or in a file written for people that nobody is told to apply.
options.not-a-match: the marked text is not a setting that runs a workload privileged or gives it access to the host.
